content_sections.heading: Digital University Kerala Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Digital University Kerala Recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, so there is no specific last date for application. Candidates need to attend the interview on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the walk-in date for the Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support posts at Digital University Kerala is scheduled for 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-II, a degree of at least three years' duration from a recognized University or Educational Institution is required.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-III, a BTech/MTech in Electronics/Bio-Medical or allied fields from a Recognized University/Educational Institution is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Project Technical Support-II and Project Technical Support-III positions is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is available for SC/ST candidates (5 years) and OBC candidates (3 years).

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Technical Support-II is Rs. 20,000 + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Technical Support-III is Rs. 25,000 + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Digital University, Campus, Mangalapuram, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, 695317.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
